scope: CPU-only qualification and workload design. No hardware execution and no main-chat notification.

tool_clock.method: Recovered original Harbor step/API intervals; one common scale, preserving relative gaps and tails.

model_notes: Model output lengths are source-model lengths or historical-Qwen medians; actual workload uses natural EOS.
Placement is a two-sided local-first hypothesis based on a historical D-only service calibration.
Abort stops new calls/active decode and charges safe draining of already-started P work/transfers. Partial generated tokens are counted in model TPS.
Healthy-short reference means a four-call window on an otherwise idle pair, not a measured production SLO.
